name: skill_add
description: Skill creator: builds new Stella skill packages from a spec. Generates manifest.json, skill.py, test_cases.json, and __init__.py following Stella's skill contract (FEATURE_METADATA + execute(**kwargs)). Supports built-in templates (read_only_tool, read_write_tool, passive_osint, active_audit) or a fully custom spec. Validates the spec before writing, previews what will be created, and never overwrites an existing skill. Writes into features/<name>/, so creating a skill needs authorized=true plus confirm=true plus a policy allow rule. No symlinks or external PC references - everything is written fresh inside this project.

operation.description: One of: sources | list_templates | validate | preview | create. Defaults to sources.

name.description: The new skill name (e.g. my_custom_skill). Required for create/preview/validate.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the skill does.

category.description: Skill category: system | security | osint | memory | docs | development | general. Defaults to general.

surface.description: Surface: desktop | android | both. Defaults to both.

triggers.description: JSON array of trigger phrases, or a comma-separated list.

parameters.description: JSON object of parameter definitions for the skill's execute().

operations.description: JSON array of operation names the skill supports (e.g. ["sources", "run"]).

template.description: Built-in template to start from: read_only_tool | read_write_tool | passive_osint | active_audit. Overrides description/parameters/operations if given.

authorized.description: Must be true to actually create skill files.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually write skill files.

limit.description: Maximum items to return. Defaults to 20.

author: Stella
notes: Writes into features/<name>/. Validates before writing; preview shows what will be created without writing. Never overwrites an existing skill. Requires authorized=true + confirm=true + an allow rule.
